title: Coast Guard launches search for missing fisherman from Quezon

blocks.text: LUCENA CITY, Quezon — The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) has launched a search-and-rescue operation for a 49-year-old fisherman who went missing after leaving his home in San Francisco, Quezon, on Monday afternoon, Nov. 16, to fish near Sombrero Island in San Pascual, Masbate. In a report issued Tuesday night, the PCG–Southern Quezon station, based in this city, identified the missing fisherman as Arnel Alojado, who failed to return home after setting out to sea.
